name: office-llm-harness-addin
description: Unified Office add-in for Office LLM Harness - connects to local MCP server

scripts.generate-manifest: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const t=fs.readFileSync('manifest.xml','utf8').replace(/{{BASE_URL}}/g,'http://127.0.0.1:3001').replace(/{{SCHEME}}/g,'http').replace(/{{HOST}}/g,'127.0.0.1:3001');fs.writeFileSync('manifest.dev.xml',t);console.log('Written manifest.dev.xml (sideload this into Office)')"
scripts.dev: npm run generate-token && npm run generate-manifest && webpack serve --mode development --port 3001
